item.title: Compositor Pathway

learningObjectives.item: Integrate CGI elements with live-action footage seamlessly
Apply color correction and grading techniques
Use keying and rotoscoping for element isolation
Create realistic lighting and shadow integration
Understand compositing workflows and node-based systems
Deliver final outputs to professional specifications

item.content:
This streamlined pathway focuses specifically on digital compositing skills, providing students with the technical and artistic abilities needed to work in post-production facilities. Students will learn to combine multiple elements into final, polished images for film, television, and digital media.

Who This Is For

This pathway is ideal for students interested in:

  • Post-production and finishing
  • Visual effects compositing
  • Color grading and correction
  • Motion graphics integration
  • Commercial production

Career Outcomes

Graduates will be prepared for roles including:

  • Digital Compositor
  • Compositing Artist
  • VFX Compositor
  • Finishing Artist
  • Color Grading Technician
  • Junior Compositor
